entities.name: Yuma
entities.description: Human ranger and former Riveteer from New Capenna who fled through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction and opened a bar.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: Capennan gang Yuma belonged to as weaponsmith and enforcer.

entities.name: Elnor
entities.description: Yuma's friend who left the Riveteers with him and later came to reclaim the money.

entities.name: Shadress
entities.description: Elnor's girlfriend, who left the Riveteers.

entities.name: Kirri
entities.description: Cactusfolk Yuma took in as an infant.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Yuma grew disillusioned with the gang.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Path between planes Yuma ran through.

events.summary: Yuma, Elnor, Shadress and others leave the Riveteers to start a co-operative.
events.quote: left the Riveteers to start their own co-operative

events.summary: Overwhelmed by debt and enemies, Yuma flees through a random Omenpath with the remaining money.
events.quote: ran through a random Omenpath with all the money they had left

events.summary: Yuma takes in an infant cactusfolk he names Kirri and opens a bar.
events.quote: Yuma encountered an infant cactusfolk he named Kirri and took him under his care

events.summary: Elnor arrives to reclaim the money; they shoot it out until Kirri intervenes and Yuma talks her into moving on.
events.quote: He was able to talk her into moving on after Kirri intervened in the fight.

relations.quote: As a member of the Riveteers, Yuma was a weaponsmith and enforcer.

relations.note: friend turned adversary over the money
relations.quote: he, together with his friend Elnor
